Welcome to /v/Ramadan!

The Holy Month is upon us brothers and sisters.

What is Ramadan?

Ramadan is the ninth month in the Islamic calendar. All Muslims are obliged to abstain from all sorts of eating and drinking from the Fajr prayer up until the sunset. Fasting is one of the five pillars of Islam. Interested in learning more about the history and origins of ramadan? click here.

What to expect from /v/Ramadan?

/v/Ramadan has been brought to existence in order to educate everyone about what this holy month is really about. For instance, many think that the month is solely existing for people to abstain from eating for two-thirds of the day and that's it - which is, obviously, a misunderstanding. Ramadan empowers all Muslims around the world around the religion and strengthens their bond with god throughout the holy month.

All Posts regarding ramadan are permissible except ones that are targetting muslims or ramadan as this is not the purpose of this subverse. This subverse is to educate the reader about ramadan.

Things to know about Ramadan

  • Suhoor: Suhoor is eating/drinking by a little bit before fajr. Once the fajr prayer sounds, all eating/drinking should be completely stopped up until Iftar. The Prophet Muhammad (Peace be upon him) recommended having Suhoor as it helps a lot in fasting.
  • Iftar: All Muslims are instructed to break their fasting on sunset everyday, and usually accompanies the eating of meals. The Prophet Muhammad (Peace be upon him) is said to break his fast everyday with three dates as a tradition.
  • Tarawih Prayers: Prayers that are exclusive to this very holy month. They are not compulsory but are a bonus if they are done.

Benefits of Ramadan

It has been suggested that fasting during Ramadan has numerous health benefits, including: improved brain function and alertness due to greater brain cell production; greatly reduced stress levels due to a reduction in cortisol; a reduction of cholesterol; a reduction of blood glucose LDL cholesterol levels; increases in HDL cholesterol; Weight loss due to the use of fat for energy while preserving muscle; decrease of waist circumference; decrease of body mass index;decrease of blood sugar; decrease of mean arterial pressure; better control of diabetes; reduced blood pressure; and a detoxification process. [Source: wikipedia]
